# External Perplexity research: physical K4 geometry correction

External documentary evidence, not an experiment; does not rewrite historical files.

## Primary source
*The CIA Kryptos Sculpture: A Summary of Previous Work and New Revelations in Working Toward Its Complete Solution*, NSA DOCID 4145037, OIA/FOIA 65414, analyst redacted, released 16 September 2014. [Official PDF](https://www.nsa.gov/portals/75/documents/news-features/declassified-documents/cia-kryptos-sculpture/KRYPTOS_Summary.pdf), printed p.4 Fig.2 and pp.13-16 Figs.14-18. Grade A for row transcription; B for metric geometry.

## Corrected geometry
OBKR is **not** a standalone row. K4 begins physical ciphertext row 25 immediately after K3's terminal question mark:
```text
ECDMRIPFEIMEHNLSSTTRTVDOHW?OBKR
UOXOGHULBSOLIFBBWFLRVQQPRNGKSSO
TWTQSJQSSEKZZWATJKLUDIAWINFBNYP
VTTMZFPKWGDKZXTJCDIGKUHUAUEKCAR
```

| K4 positions | Row | Columns |
|---|---:|---:|
| 1-4 | 25 | 28-31 |
| 5-35 | 26 | 1-31 |
| 36-66 | 27 | 1-31 |
| 67-97 | 28 | 1-31 |

The conceptual `OBKR` plus three 31 rows is only sectional transcription, not engraving. Cipher side: 869 characters including four question marks; 28 rows; first has 32, remaining 27 have 31; not uniform 28x31.

NSA typeset transcription proves row membership/order, not millimetre coordinates, vertical alignment, spacing, Cartesian positions, or tiny intentional deviations; orthographic/fabrication/rubbing/survey evidence is required.
